easyPrerequisites: Medicine Runner does not have a flying counter on it.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Medicine Runner, adding one mana of any color.
When Medicine Runner dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Medicine Runner from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Medicine Runner enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Medicine Runner.
Repeat.
